Double Degree AI), Computer Engineering and Electronics, Robotics, Transport and Logistics, Aviation Engineering; Bachelor (3yr, 180 ECTS): Business and Management; Master (1.5-2yr, 90-120 ECTS): Management of Information Systems (incl. Double Degree IT Project Mgmt), Computer Science Software Engineering, Double Degree Data Analytics & AI, Computer Engineering and Electronics, Intelligent Transport and Smart Logistics, Business and Management, Double Degree Aviation Management; PhD (3yr): Telematics and Logistics, Digital Economy and Business. The genuine catalog programs match these reasonably well, so PROGRAMS scored 'stale' (right titles but wrong durations + junk entries needing cleanup) rather than 'wrong'. So real prices exist in EUR but catalog has none -> 'absent' (plus wrong currency flag). CAMPUSES: catalog city='Latvia'; official city is Riga -> 'wrong'.
